title: Coloured Mighty Stand Gold/Silver/Rainbow/White/Orange
description:
There is not much wrong with the Mighty being one of the most popular vaporizers ever to hit the market. But one thing it does struggle with is standing tall. And now with the mighty stand this is a whole lot easier.
Caution: This stand is extremely tight. And is really meant to be left on once installed.
THIS STAND WILL NOT FIT THE MIGHTY+
Included
1 x Mighty Stand (Please Choose Colour)
